main_text.head: §. Ægy- ptiacu.In Ægypto regnârunt Ptolemaei.
Explicatio.
main_text.p: Primus regum fuit Ptolemæus Lagi, cujus omnis posteritas Ptole-mæi dicta. Fuerunt autem omnes profligatissimæ vitæ, & monstra virorum. Ab Ægypto avulsum regnum Lybiæ aridæ, & Cyrenes, quod rex Ptolemæus Apion Romanis testamento legavit.
Regum seriem clausit Cleopatra, uxor Marci Antonii, debellata ab Augusto. Sic totum Imperium Macedonicum ad Romanos concessit.

page.notes: The margin note "§. Ægy-ptiacu." is set beside the title; its first word is hyphenated across the line end and is written here as printed. The strip at the right edge is part of the neighbouring page and was left out. The word "conceffit" is printed with the long-s ligature, read as "concessit". No other doubtful readings.
